synth.notes:
Frame-native, stateless: parse 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (axis ring 10 / dot 0 when selected, targets 11, pieces ring 5 with 0 centre when selected, reflections ring 4).
A1/A2 move the selection one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece one column, blocked by board edge or other pieces; A3/A4 do nothing when the axis is selected.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces (largest first) -> axis. Reflections drawn at row 2A-r, skipping pieces on the axis row, off-board destinations and blocks already covered by a piece. Target 11 shows through holes.
HUD col 63: one 11->12 from the top per action that changes the board (no-ops do not tick).
Unconfirmed: whether pieces may enter the axis row (allowed in this rule); clicks/A7 treated as no-ops.
